options.label: Cadiro's Gambit arrow:
options.tooltip: Select one arrow for the selected bow-arrow skill. Unspecified is neutral. Crescendo adds 6 chains and 60% increased Damage per explicitly configured prior chain; Splinter splits to 6 targets; Reversing pierces all targets and can return; Diamond always critically hits with 60% increased Critical Damage Bonus; Covetous grants 600% increased Rarity only on its kills; Blunt grants 600% increased Stun Buildup. No probability average, extra return hits or loot outcome is assumed.
